{{Top|leg|italics=1|title2=''Assassin''-class}}
The '''''Keeper''''' was a [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|CR92a ''Assassin''-class corvette]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] attempted to dock and pick up the stolen prototype [[Missile Boat]] ''[[Sealion]]'' from the Rebel [[XQ4 Platform]] ''[[Enin'sd]]'' but was destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
